newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Hochtief, Deutsche Bank file Holzmann deal with EU.
newsitem.headline: Hochtief, Deutsche Bank file Holzmann deal with EU.

text.p: The European Commission said on Thursday that Hochtief AG and Deutsche Bank AG had requested clearance for their proposed joint control of German building firm Philip Holzmann AG.
It said in a notice that the deal was notified on April 15 under the European Union's merger rules which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions.
The German Cartel Office said last month that it would ask the Commission to refer the case back to Germany on the grounds that it affects competition primarily in the national building sector.
The Commission's routine notice makes no mention of the request and it was not immediately possible to confirm whether Germany had already filed it.

A Commission official said last month that the request would be examined in due time and competition lawyers speculated there was a good chance that the EU would agree to it because the European building industry was still to a large extent fragmented along national lines.
The Commission has a month from the date the deal was notified to clear it or start a full probe.
